newsitem.title: USA: Schulman sees Q3 EPS above analysts' view.
newsitem.headline: Schulman sees Q3 EPS above analysts' view.

text.p: A. Schulman Inc said earnings for its third quarter ended May 31 "should exceed analyst estimates of $0.34 to $0.36 per common share."
Earnings in last year's third quarter were $12.1 million or $.32 per share, said the Akron, Ohio-based high performance plastic compound and resin supplier.
At an investment conference here Wednesday, the company said business has been good throughout worldwide operations.

"European backlogs are strong, but there has been some recent softening in North America resulting from labor disruptions in the automotive market. Nevertheless, the company anticipates good fourth quarter earnings," it said.

The company said, "Earnings for fiscal 1997 could exceed last year by 20 percent. Looking beyond fiscal 1997, A. Schulman's goals call for earnings growth of at least 10 percent annually and a return on equity of 15 percent."
Shares in the company were up 1-1/2 to 21-5/8.
The company is projected to earn $1.31 per share in its current fiscal year, according to the First Call consensus of five Wall Street analysts' estimates.
